title: CacoPack
description: Replaces the Ghast with the Cacodemon from Doom.
body:
Replaces the Ghast with the Cacodemon from Doom.

Requires [OptiFine](https://optifine.net/home). OptiFine alternatives will probably work as well, but that hasn't been tested.

It'll also probably work just fine on some older/newer versions of the game, even if it says it's incompatible. It's a very simple pack.
